customers_say: Customers find the smart door lock to be of excellent quality, with smooth installation that doesn't damage the door. Moreover, the lock works as expected with no issues, and customers appreciate its user-friendly app, multiple unlock options, and top-notch security features that transform home security management. Additionally, the product receives positive feedback for its well-explained features. However, customers have mixed opinions about responsiveness.

reviews.author: karishma
reviews.title: My Door lock installation done after 4 days of delivery
reviews.body: The door lock itself is good, does the job. To unlock the door when away from home you need to buy Wifi gateway separately. No proper contact details for Mygate brand, no communication was done from the brand after delivery, needed to go to mygate app, manually request for installation, that too only limited slots were available. The brand number provided by Amazon is unresponsive. Installation was done successfully after 4 days of delivery, KP Chary was prompt and did wonderful job. Yet to see how post installation service is going to be..!!

reviews.author: Anurag G.
reviews.title: Amazing product by Shyam !
reviews.body: Amazing product and Shyam did an amazing job in installation. Quick and easy and explained the product really well !

reviews.body: KP Chary installation associate who came for installation was super helpful and polite while being knowledgable. The lock itself is very friendly and convenient for our requirements
